summary.one_liner: evo.ninja is an autonomous agent tool that runs a loop of predicting, selecting, and executing steps toward a user goal, switching between specialist personas, with a CLI and a Supabase-backed web UI.
summary.what_it_does: Evo takes a user goal and runs an execution loop until the goal is judged achieved. Each iteration it predicts the next step, selects the best-fit agent persona (Synthesizer for text files, Csv Analyst for CSV data, Researcher for internet search, Developer for software building with a Python focus), trims the chat history to the most relevant messages, and then evaluates and executes an agent function. The agent reads and writes only inside a per-session workspace under ./sessions, and keeps a chat.md markdown log of its output plus optional debug logs. It can be run from the terminal with goal, session, timeout, and debug options, or through a UI that the README says depends on a local Supabase database run via Docker.
use_cases: autonomous task execution from a single goal
summarizing and reporting on text files
analyzing and extracting insights from CSV data
generating Python software with an AI agent
how_to_run: cp .env.template .env, then set OPENAI_API_KEY and SERP_API_KEY in .env
yarn start (CLI); for UI: cd apps/browser, yarn db:start, update .env.local, yarn dev
notable: Switches between predefined agent personas on every loop iteration based on the predicted next step
Sandboxes the agent to a per-session workspace directory
Writes a markdown chat.md transcript of agent output
Website available for use without building from source
caveats: Requires paid-style API keys for OpenAI and SERP API before it runs
The UI requires Docker Desktop running and a local Supabase database that can take about 3 minutes to start
Setup needs git, nodejs, yarn, and nvm installed
keywords: run ai to achieve a goal
